name: Societe Arabe Internationale de Banque (SAIB)
source: Saib Bank audited financial statements, statement of income, year ended 31 December 2025 (KPMG Hazem Hassan and Kreston Egypt), page 4 of the English translation; comparatives 2024 from the same statement, 2023 and 2022 from the audited statements for the year ended 31 December 2023, page 4. Amounts are in USD, which is the presentation currency the bank prints in its own column headers. Revenue is derived: net interest income plus net fees and commissions plus dividend income plus net trading income plus gains on financial investments, all printed lines on the same statement. Net finance costs are not shown as a separate row because the printed statement nets interest expense on deposits inside net interest income, so showing it again would double count it; the impairment charge for expected credit losses and other operating expense also sit between revenue and profit before tax and have no row in this panel. | income gaps filled from Yahoo Finance (secondary feed), identity gated

rows.label: Revenue
rows.formula: net interest income + net fees and commissions income + dividend income + net trading income + gains on financial investments

rows.label: ROE (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: ROE (%) = Net Profit / Total Equity x 100

rows.label: ROA (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: ROA (%) = Net Profit / Total Assets x 100

rows.label: Debt to Equity
rows.derivedCellFormula: Debt to Equity = Total Liabilities / Total Equity
